correctness.rationale: Matrix-forest theorem yields partition polynomial q(q+N)(q+a)^(b-1)(q+b)^(a-1) and independent Bernoulli root indicators. Pair a-1 old (q/(q+a),q/(q+b)) Bernoulli factors against new (q/(q+a+1),q/(q+b-1)) factors: degree 0,1,2 coefficients proportional to (ab,qN,q^2) versus ((a+1)(b-1),qN,q^2), so each pair has the asserted likelihood-ratio orientation. Remaining singles decrease strictly. Convolution by independent Poisson-binomial log-concave factors preserves LR order (TP2 Toeplitz kernel); interval-positive support and a strict Bernoulli change give strict all interior tails. Sum of individual means simplifies to printed rational gap. Verified exact LR minors, tails and mean for N<=11 and three positive rational fugacities. Algebraic proof covers all finite N and real q>0.
